heading: Project: Relay
text: Relay is a project I built. A self-healing pull-request pipeline built for the LabLab AMD "Band of Agents" AI developer hackathon: hand it a GitHub issue and four AI agents carry it from triage to a human-approved merge. Four agents, each built in a different framework — LangGraph, PydanticAI, CrewAI, and a deterministic no-LLM Python security agent — share no code and no memory between them. They collaborate entirely through a single Band chatroom: every handoff is an @mention, and the review-and-fix loop runs in the room until the reviewer and the security agent both clear. The security gate is deliberately LLM-free — secret scan, dependency diff, and the full test suite in plain Python — so nothing about it can be hallucinated. The hackathon demo fixes a real pricing bug, taking six failing tests to green to a merged PR. It ran for the event on GCP behind FastAPI and Caddy over HTTPS. Built with LangGraph, PydanticAI, CrewAI, FastAPI, GCP, Caddy. Source: https://github.com/moeezahmadkhangit/Relay-LabLab

heading: Project: Project Horus
text: Project Horus is a project I built. An automated pipeline that identifies students from live video, matching faces against an enrolled index in real time. Detects faces in real time with YOLO and SCRFD, then generates ArcFace embeddings for each detection. Matches those embeddings against a FAISS vector index to assign identity. Tuned for reliability across varied edge-case environments and high-throughput processing. Built with YOLO, SCRFD, ArcFace, FAISS.

text: QuerySphere is a project I built. Some people write it Query Sphere.
